evidence.note: Claim: text-mode `ddflow wait` (capped) says "resume with the token" and "Try later; `ddflow wait` again" but never prints the resume token, so a non-json caller cannot actually resume. Mechanism: `_note_cap` and `_finish` reference "the token" without interpolating `resume`; only data["wake"]["token"] (--json) carries it. Falsifier: token present in text output on unfixed code. Test: tests/test_wait_bounded.py::test_a_capped_wait_hands_back_the_token_its_advice_names — FAILED on unfixed (cap note "resume with the token to wait longer", no token), PASSED after the fix (token in both cap note and exit-2 follow-up). Verdict: CONFIRMED.

Loaded rules via brief/claim guidance: r-gemini-key-load (export GEMINI_API_KEY before gemini/google review; done before critic gate), r-task-phase-needs-wave, and the standing operator decisions in session.agent_brief_extra (cross-family critic; selected-scope ci/unit_tests before merge; pins regenerated not hand-merged).

Commit c2afc01: `_note_cap` interpolates the resume token into the cap note; `_finish` names it in the exit-2 follow-up. Regression test FAILED on unfixed, PASSED after; tests/test_wait_bounded.py green (5 passed).
